title: Volatility: ATR and Bollinger Bands
summary: ATR shows how far price has typically moved per candle. Bollinger Bands widen when price has been jumpy and squeeze when it has been calm. Neither shows direction.
unreliableWhen: Both describe the past, so they can be low just before a sudden news move. A band touch is not "too high", since price can ride a band in a trend. A squeeze can break either way, or not at all.
goodExample: Seeing ATR 14 at 12 pips and widening a 5-pip stop, then reducing the size to keep the same money at risk.
badExample: Selling every touch of the upper band in a strong uptrend.

chart.lookFor: Compare ATR 14 and the band width at the start and end of the chart. Then open Low volatility and look for a squeeze.
